_comment: Fetched from NOAA NCEI search service (dataset=daily-summaries, station USC00058022) on 2026-09-25. Do not edit.
name: STRONTIA SPRINGS DAM, CO US
network: COOP (NWS Cooperative Observer Program): a volunteer/utility observer reads a standard 8-inch gauge once a day at a fixed observation time; TOBS (temperature at observation time) is in the record, which is the COOP signature.
siting_note: The gauge stands at Strontia Springs Dam, the OUTLET of the roughly 2,600 sq mi basin the simulation routes, some 1,000 m below the SNOTEL pillows and 30-180 km downstream of where storms actually fall on South Park and the Platte canyons.
